payload.claim: Criterion 6's witness re-implements a subset of GNU make's recipe semantics by hand (joining backslash continuations, splitting each logical line into its own `sh -c`, stripping a leading `@`/`-`/`+`, turning `$$` into `$`, blanking other `$` references, stopping at the first non-zero exit) because the cell image has no `make`. The spec states this emulation was cross-checked against real `make` once on a prototype, but that cross-check is not a committed, repeatable artifact in this repository, so a future divergence between the hand-rolled interpreter and actual GNU make semantics would go undetected by this test suite.
